lead: Paul Pogba is a widely followed French association football player, born on 15 March 1993 in Lagny-sur-Marne.
As of 2026, he is 33 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has represented France national under-20 association football team and France national under-16 association football team and has been recognised with the Knight of the Legion of Honour.
The sections that follow break down Paul Pogba's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Paul Pogba — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Paul Pogba was born on 15 March 1993 in Lagny-sur-Marne, and holds French nationality. He was given the name Paul Labilé Pogba at birth and is publicly known as Paul Pogba.
He is a sibling of Mathias Pogba and Florentin Pogba.
He is recorded as speaking French, Italian and English.

sections.heading: Paul Pogba — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists association football player as his main occupation.

On the team sheet, Paul has been associated with France national under-20 association football team (from 2012 to 2013), France national under-16 association football team (from 2008 to 2009), France national under-17 association football team (from 2009 to 2010), France national under-18 association football team (from 2010 to 2011), France national under-19 association football team (from 2011 to 2012), France national under-17 association football team (from 2010 to 2010), Juventus FC (from 2012 to 2016) and France men's national association football team (from 2013 to 2022). He plays as a midfielder.
He has taken part in 2014 FIFA World Cup, UEFA Euro 2016, 2018 FIFA World Cup, 2018 FIFA World Cup qualification – UEFA Group A and Middle East and Africa Summit 2020.
